sentences.en: Successive governments have failed to address the country's crumbling infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 连续几届政府都没有解决国家基础设施崩坏的问题。

sentences.en: Successive economic crises long ago became an ideological soap opera.
sentences.zh: 一次接一次的经济危机早就成了意识形态的肥皂剧。

sentences.en: I went there by myself, often on successive evenings.
sentences.zh: 我经常在连续几个晚上独自去那里。

senses.zh: 连续的，相继的,继承的，接替的,逐次
